name: Staidson (Beijing) BioPharmaceuticals Co., Ltd.
summary: Staidson (Beijing) BioPharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and marketing of therapeutic and biological drugs in China. The company offers protein drugs, including therapeutic monoclonal antibody drugs; chemical drugs; and drugs for urinary, intestinal, infectious, autoimmune, nervous system, and other diseases. It also provides treatments for respiratory and critical care illnesses, and neurological disorders.
